Storefront and customer routes of the checkout module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/checkout/settings

Get the public checkout settings and the enabled payment methods

Responses:

- `200`: Checkout bootstrap payload retrieved.
